_readme: Fitted parameters only — never dataset rows. This is what DATA_SOURCES.md's
attribution section asks for: committing distributions rather than the
observations they were fitted to is smaller, licence-clean, and keeps the
seed deterministic. Every number below is an integer (minor units, basis
points, or days) because backend/seed is float-free like the rest of the
Each block names the source it was derived from and the derivation, so a
reviewer can re-fit it rather than take it on trust.

balance_sheet_scale.source: SEC EDGAR XBRL frames, us-gaap concepts for a peer set of ~$400-500M revenue SaaS filers
balance_sheet_scale.derivation: median cash/revenue, AR/revenue, AP/revenue and revolver utilization across the peer set, scaled to a $450M revenue entity

collection_behaviour.source: IBM Finance Factoring late-payment histories; payment-date-prediction invoice set; Olist order-to-payment timestamps
collection_behaviour.derivation: two-component payment-delay mixture fitted per customer segment on days(paid - due); collection probability fitted per aging bucket
collection_behaviour.note: The mixture is the point. Real invoice delay is bimodal, not normal — fitting a mean puts cash in a week where none arrives.

rates.source: US Treasury Fiscal Data average interest rates and the daily Treasury yield curve; FRED SOFR
rates.derivation: SOFR as the revolver base rate; credit spread from IG corporate OAS at a single-B-plus equivalent

covenants.derivation: modal Consolidated Leverage Ratio ceiling and Interest Coverage floor for facilities of this size, with quarterly testing on TTM adjusted EBITDA

vendor_concentration.source: USAspending contract values; Olist seller distribution; SEC 10-K supplier-concentration disclosures
vendor_concentration.derivation: Pareto spend curve, roughly 80% of spend across 20% of vendors, with criticality assigned independently of spend

processor.source: Dodo Payments API reference — Transaction Failures and Error Codes; Payouts and Balance Ledger
processor.derivation: rolling success rate and the soft/hard decline split taken from the documented failure taxonomy; payout lag from the balance-ledger to payout gap

bank.derivation: pending-vs-posted ratio and value-date lag by payment method

ar._concentration_note: Top-5 customers hold roughly 38% of AR, matching the peer-set median.
ar._lag_mixture_note: weight_bps must sum to 10000 per segment; lag_days is days after the due date

ap._pareto_note: spend_weight_bps are relative weights across the vendor list, steeply decaying

processor._decline_note: Soft declines are retry-recoverable per Dodo's documented taxonomy; hard declines are not. Never invent a recovery percentage.

history._error_note: Per-category forecast noise, applied to historical versions so backtesting has something to measure. Basis points of the cell amount, widening with horizon.
